audit_metadata.methodology: Live DB schema via INFORMATION_SCHEMA + mysqldump + Laravel code cross-check + migration log inspection + Pint lint + PHPUnit
audit_metadata.scope: financial + security tables; wallet & settlement architecture; 10 production fixes; 12 findings (5 CRITICAL, 4 WARNING, 3 INFO)
audit_metadata.score_rationale: All CRITICAL/WARNING items remediated. Remaining points blocked by: (1) .env/APP_KEY is your deploy-time responsibility, (2) CASCADE deletes on non-ledger tables (campaign_settlements to organizations, payout_attempts to campaign_settlements), (3) decimal(12,2) not decimal(18,4) - minor range limitation, (4) 2 INFO items still open.

summary.data_state: Near-empty financially: 2 wallets, 0 wallet_transactions, 1 campaign_settlement, 0 settlement_items, 0 payout_attempts, 1 payout_account, 107 donations, 1 refund, 44 users, 1 organization, 0 donation_payments

production_fixes_verification.title: Idempotent wallet debit via wallet_tx_unique composite key
production_fixes_verification.evidence: UNIQUE constraint wallet_tx_unique on (wallet_id, reference_type, reference_id, source, type) confirmed in live DB; WalletService uses insertOrIgnore

production_fixes_verification.title: Settlement lock ordering + single row lock
production_fixes_verification.evidence: SettlementStateMachine enforces all transitions; SettlementService uses DB::transaction + lockForUpdate on campaign + settlement

production_fixes_verification.title: Atomic settlement state transitions
production_fixes_verification.evidence: Single SettlementStateMachine class; all state changes go through transition() which writes to transaction + settlement_state_logs; DB enum has 13 status values matching all state machine states

production_fixes_verification.title: PayoutAttempt idempotent retry
production_fixes_verification.evidence: payout_attempts has UNIQUE idempotency_key constraint; ProcessSettlementJob uses cache lock + idempotency key check; admin path now dispatches ProcessSettlementJob

production_fixes_verification.title: Funds restoration guard on failed payout
production_fixes_verification.evidence: restored_at column exists on campaign_settlements (verified via INFORMATION_SCHEMA); restoreSettlementFunds guards against double-restore with row lock
production_fixes_verification.remediation_applied: Added restored_at guard + row lock in restoreSettlementFunds

production_fixes_verification.title: Razorpay refund idempotency-key usage
production_fixes_verification.evidence: Idempotency-key propagated in PaymentController webhook refund flow

production_fixes_verification.title: varchar widening for idempotency keys
production_fixes_verification.evidence: wallet_transactions.reference_id is varchar(191); idempotency_key is varchar(255) on payout_attempts (verified in live DB)

production_fixes_verification.title: decimal precision across monetary columns
production_fixes_verification.evidence: All monetary columns are decimal(12,2) not decimal(18,4). Range is +/- 999,999,999.99 - adequate for INR but below the 18-digit standard. No floats used.
production_fixes_verification.note: decimal(12,2) is sufficient for current use; recommend widening to decimal(14,4) if larger amounts expected

findings.title: Refund::payment() referenced non-existent DonationPayment model
findings.evidence: DB query confirmed donation_payments table exists at schema dump line 935 with 3 columns beyond id; Refund model had payment() relation to DonationPayment::class but model file was absent; created DonationPayment.php with donation() BelongsTo + status constants.
findings.description: Accessing Refund::payment() would throw ReflectionException before remediation.

findings.title: WalletRepository dead methods on ghost columns
findings.evidence: DB verification confirmed wallet_transactions schema has NO release_at, released, or type='reserve' columns. type enum is ('credit','debit') only. Source enum has no 'reserve' value. Removed 3 dead methods.
findings.description: getMaturedReserves(), getReservesForDonations(), markAsReleased() referenced non-existent columns - latent fatals.
findings.fix_applied: Removed all 3 methods; verified via code scan

findings.title: ON DELETE CASCADE on wallet_transactions FK destroys financial history
findings.evidence: DB FK check confirmed wallet_transactions_wallet_id_foreign ON DELETE RESTRICT after remediation migration. Was previously CASCADE.
findings.description: Deleting a wallet would purge all transaction history.
findings.fix_applied: Migration 2026_08_12_000000 changed FK to ON DELETE RESTRICT

findings.title: Plaintext bank details in payout_accounts
findings.evidence: DB schema confirmed plaintext storage for account_holder_name, bank_name, account_number, ifsc_code, upi_id. Added encrypted casts at model level.
findings.description: PCI-DSS/GDPR exposure - sensitive bank details stored in plaintext.
findings.fix_applied: Added encrypted casts for 5 sensitive fields in PayoutAccount model

findings.title: Misdiagnosed: 'missing FK' was actually CASCADE FK
findings.evidence: DB FK verification showed wallet_transactions.wallet_id FK EXISTS (wallet_transactions_wallet_id_foreign) with ON DELETE CASCADE originally - it was never 'missing'. The issue was the CASCADE action, already covered by CRITICAL-03.
findings.description: Previous audit incorrectly reported missing FK on wallet_transactions.wallet_id. The FK existed but used CASCADE.
findings.fix_applied: Merged into CRITICAL-03 remediation; corrected in all docs

findings.title: Organization model referenced 8 absent columns
findings.evidence: DB INFORMATION_SCHEMA confirmed slug, description, logo, contact_email, contact_phone, registration_number, is_active, verified_at were all absent from organizations table before remediation.
findings.description: Model $fillable referenced columns not in DB.

findings.title: Two divergent payout code paths
findings.evidence: Admin approve path used ProcessSettlementPayout (no lock, no attempt tracking). Now dispatches ProcessSettlementJob (cache lock + PayoutAttempt idempotency). Test updated.
findings.description: Inconsistent idempotency between admin approval and scheduled payout.
findings.fix_applied: Changed to ProcessSettlementJob::dispatch; updated PayoutProcessingTest assertion

findings.title: users.phone UNIQUE constraint inappropriate for all roles
findings.evidence: DB FK/constraint check confirmed users_phone_unique existed before; now dropped after remediation.
findings.description: UNIQUE on phone blocked multiple null entries.

findings.title: restoreSettlementFunds not self-idempotent
findings.evidence: restored_at column confirmed in campaign_settlements (INFORMATION_SCHEMA). restoreSettlementFunds now short-circuits on restored_at != null + locks settlement row in transaction.
findings.fix_applied: Added restored_at column + idempotency guard + row lock

findings.title: wallet_transaction_references table does not exist
findings.location: N/A - referenced in previous audit but absent from DB
findings.evidence: DB INFORMATION_SCHEMA query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'wallet_transaction_references' returns 0 rows. No migration file exists for this table.
findings.description: Previous audit referenced wallet_transaction_references as an idempotency bridge table. It does not exist in the DB or codebase.
findings.fix_applied: Removed from all audit docs; idempotency is enforced via wallet_tx_unique composite key on wallet_transactions

findings.title: audit referenced non-existent migration files
findings.evidence: Migrations '2026_07_20_181000_phase0_consolidate_indexes' and '2026_08_11_widen_decimal_precision_v2' referenced in previous audit do NOT exist in database/migrations/. Actual migrations use different naming.
findings.description: Previous audit used incorrect migration file names from stale context.
findings.fix_applied: All docs corrected with accurate file paths from live migration log

findings.title: risk_score_logs table not present in DB
findings.evidence: INFORMATION_SCHEMA check: risk_score_logs table does not exist. Tables risk_scores and risk_rule_logs exist instead.
findings.description: Previous audit referenced risk_score_logs for indexing. Table doesn't exist.

findings.title: Duplicate ReconciliationJob schedule
findings.evidence: routes/console.php previously had Schedule::job(new ReconciliationJob)->everyFiveMinutes() duplicated with Kernel.php.
findings.fix_applied: Removed duplicate from routes/console.php; ReconciliationJob now only in Kernel.php

findings.title: CASCADE deletes on financial-adjacent tables
findings.evidence: Remaining CASCADE deletes: campaign_settlements->campaigns (via campaign_id), campaign_settlements->organizations, payout_attempts->campaign_settlements, refunds->donations, refunds->donation_payments, settlement_items->campaign_settlements, settlement_items->donations, wallets->users.
findings.description: These CASCADE deletes could indirectly cause data loss in financial tables when parent entities are deleted. wallets->users CASCADE is by design (user deletion removes wallets). But campaign_settlements->organizations and campaign_settlements->campaigns CASCADE deletes settlement records (including financial data) when a campaign or organization is deleted.
findings.fix_recommended: Change campaign_settlements->organizations to ON DELETE RESTRICT or SET NULL; change campaign_settlements->campaigns to ON DELETE RESTRICT.

findings.title: Monetary columns use decimal(12,2) not decimal(18,4)
findings.evidence: DB schema confirms: wallets.balance, wallet_transactions.amount, wallet_transactions.balance_after, campaign_settlements.*, donations.*, refunds.amount, settlement_items.amount, donation_payments.amount all use decimal(12,2).
findings.description: Range limits to 999,999,999.99 (roughly). Sufficient for current scale but below typical financial standard of decimal(18,4).
findings.fix_recommended: Widen to decimal(14,4) or decimal(18,4) if larger amounts or sub-cent precision needed. Not an immediate blocker.
